description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is seeking a Software Engineer to support software development activities for space-related mission applications. The role involves designing, developing, documenting, testing, debugging, integrating, and maintaining software while applying established development standards and processes.
Software engineer developing, testing, debugging, and documenting business and mission applications

Responsibilities:
• Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities
• Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment
• Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle
• Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software
• Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls
• Ensures software standards are met

Requirements:
• Experience with programming languages such as C, C++, or Python
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering or other related degree programs from an accredited college/university
• Must be a US Citizen; This position is located at a facility that requires special access

Preferred:
• Knowledge of Agile Software Development
• Demonstrated experience or classroom knowledge with embedded software/hardware
• Ability to work in a collaborative and team-based environment
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to perform software integration and test
• Experience with software development
• Experience with Python
• Experience working on teams using Agile practices
• Experience working in a Lab environment with Linux embedded systems
• Automated test experience with tools like Jupiter
• Experience with Git, Jira, and DevOps
